answerCheck.derivedAnswer: B: Parallel to each other and congruent
answerCheck.reason: A prism's bases are congruent polygons in parallel planes; the pentagonal prism shown illustrates this relationship.
The marked lateral face has two lateral edges, its left and right vertical boundaries. Both are perpendicular to the base; its other two boundary edges lie in the bases.
A hexagonal prism has 6 lateral faces and 2 hexagonal bases, giving 6 + 2 = 8 faces.
An n-sided prism has n edges on each base and n lateral edges, totaling 3n. Thus 3n = 21 gives n = 7.
